title: Relay - paired stakeholder map
source: Fictional Relay stakeholder exercise before D-001 baseline approval
scope: Pilot planning boundary; placements are qualitative working hypotheses
state: administrator representation and several engagement assumptions require validation
decision_boundary: Use the paired maps to plan engagement while preserving domain-specific acceptance and funding authority.

dimensions.power_basis: Ability to shape, regulate, approve or block the pilot within a stated domain.
dimensions.interest_basis: Demonstrated or credibly evidenced engagement with the pilot outcome.
dimensions.impact_basis: Material consequence to workflow, access, workload, accountability or service outcomes.
dimensions.placement_warning: Categories are qualitative hypotheses; no measured coordinates or within-quadrant ranking are supplied.
dimensions.authority_warning: Participation, technical influence and evidence contribution do not automatically create formal approval authority.

stakeholders.name: Ada
stakeholders.evidence: Sponsor authority is supplied; high interest and accountability impact remain working hypotheses for validation.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on scope, funding and exception decisions.
stakeholders.authority: Funding and baseline authority; no inferred security or service acceptance authority.
stakeholders.migration_action: Bring decision-ready options with consequence and evidence boundaries.
stakeholders.trigger: Material scope, funding, date or residual-exposure choice.

stakeholders.name: Omar
stakeholders.evidence: Engineering role is supplied; allocation and exact influence boundary are not.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on feasibility, interfaces and executable evidence.
stakeholders.authority: Technical influence; no automatic funding, security or service acceptance authority.
stakeholders.migration_action: Confirm allocation and involve Omar in feasibility and recovery evidence planning.
stakeholders.trigger: Architecture, interface, capacity or recovery assumption changes.

stakeholders.name: Lena
stakeholders.power_domain: Security acceptance at the readiness gate
stakeholders.evidence: Security acceptance role is supplied; direct daily-workflow impact is assessed lower than affected operators.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely at readiness with applicable evidence and review lead time.
stakeholders.authority: Security acceptance only; no generalized budget or service authority.
stakeholders.migration_action: Confirm criteria, review availability and evidence applicability.
stakeholders.trigger: Security evidence, configuration or readiness boundary changes.
stakeholders.note: Domain-specific power must not be generalized.

stakeholders.name: Theo
stakeholders.evidence: Service-owner role is supplied; current concerns and acceptance needs remain to elicit.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on support, recovery usability and handover.
stakeholders.authority: Service acceptance; distinct from security and funding authority.
stakeholders.migration_action: Document operational acceptance needs and include Theo in relevant evidence review.
stakeholders.trigger: Support, recovery, coverage or handover boundary changes.

stakeholders.name: Priya
stakeholders.evidence: Product-owner role is supplied; stakeholder-representation action remains proposed.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Manage closely on outcome, criteria and affected-user representation.
stakeholders.authority: Backlog-ordering authority; separate from sponsor funding power.
stakeholders.migration_action: Confirm representation coverage and connect material feedback to acceptance and risk records.
stakeholders.trigger: Scope, user population or acceptance criteria changes.

stakeholders.name: Pilot tenant administrators
stakeholders.evidence: Likely high workflow impact is a hypothesis; no named participant or elicited interest is supplied.
stakeholders.engagement_strategy: Do not choose monitor from silence; recruit representative input before the relevant acceptance review.
stakeholders.authority: No formal approval authority assigned; evidence contribution does not replace Lena or Theo.
stakeholders.migration_target: Keep informed with deliberate Q1 voice elevation
stakeholders.migration_action: Identify representative administrators and run workflow and recovery feedback with explicit issue disposition.
stakeholders.trigger: Representative identified, criteria freeze approaches or pilot workflow changes.
stakeholders.note: Unknown interest is not low interest.

events.label: Mapping cutoff
events.state: Six roles are mapped; administrator representation and interest remain unconfirmed.

events.label: D-001 baseline decision
events.state: Later than this map; authority evidence updates the next snapshot.

presentation.headline: Unknown interest stays outside the grid
presentation.lede: Compare engagement strategy with consequence and voice so affected administrators do not disappear behind the named leaders.
presentation.decision: Identify representative administrators, validate their workflow impact and preserve Lena's and Theo's distinct acceptance roles.

analysis.method: Run Power x Interest and Impact x Power independently, then compare the qualitative placements.
analysis.comparison_rule: Q1 stakeholders outside manage-closely require an explicit voice-elevation decision; unknowns remain outside the grids.
analysis.voice_rule: A named research, trial or review role elevates evidence contribution without automatically changing formal power.
analysis.authority_boundary: Power is domain-specific; security, service, backlog and funding authority are not interchangeable.
analysis.revisit_rule: Reassess after baseline approval, named representation, scope changes, organization changes or actual delegated authority.
